SEARCH
Package Model.SearchStrategies

Class SearchDateStrategy

java.lang.Object
Model.SearchStrategies.SearchDateStrategy
All Implemented Interfaces:
SearchStrategyInterface<com.google.firebase.Timestamp[]>
public class SearchDateStrategy extends Object implements SearchStrategyInterface<com.google.firebase.Timestamp[]>
A SearchStrategyInterface implementation that finds Business or Course entities whose scheduled times fall between two provided Timestamp values.

The two-element Timestamp[] represents an arbitrary interval; the strategy normalizes to “time-of-day” on January 1, 1970, and matches courses whose schedule.occurrence lies within that range on the same “day” of week.

  • Method Details

    • searchBusinesses

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<List<Business>> searchBusinesses(com.google.firebase.Timestamp[] times)
      Searches for Business entities that offer courses whose scheduled occurrence falls between the two provided timestamps.
      1. Validates exactly two timestamps are supplied.
      2. Sorts them into min/max.
      3. Extracts the Day of week from the earlier timestamp.
      4. Normalizes both to time-only Timestamp at 1970-01-01 UTC.
      5. Performs a collectionGroup query on “courses” where day matches and occurrence ∈ [normMin, normMax].
      6. Groups resulting courses by their parent business document reference.
      7. Fetches each business’s document and attaches its list of matching courses.
      Specified by:
      searchBusinesses in interface SearchStrategyInterface<com.google.firebase.Timestamp[]>
      Parameters:
      times - two-element array of Timestamps defining the search interval
      Returns:
      a Task completing with a List of matching Business objects, each populated with the relevant Course subcollection; or an empty list if none match.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if times.length != 2.

    • searchCourses

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<List<Course>> searchCourses(com.google.firebase.Timestamp[] times)
      Searches for Course entities whose scheduled occurrence falls between two provided timestamps.
      1. Validates two timestamps.
      2. Sorts into min/max.
      3. Extracts Day of week.
      4. Normalizes timestamps to time-only at 1970-01-01.
      5. Performs a collectionGroup query on “courses” matching day and occurrence within the time window.
      6. Maps each result to a Course and populates its businessId.
      Specified by:
      searchCourses in interface SearchStrategyInterface<com.google.firebase.Timestamp[]>
      Parameters:
      times - two-element array of Timestamps for the time window
      Returns:
      a Task completing with a List of matching Course objects
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if times.length != 2.
